# Local measurements on cb2 (Apple M3 Max, 2026-11-07)

Measured by the coordinator on this machine, not from the web. Treat as primary data for cb2.

## Sample
5,000 realistic claim sets: iss https://auth.example.com, aud from 4 values, sub user-NNNNNN,
iat and exp 15 minutes apart (RFC 3339 strings, as cb2 writes them), jti a random UUID,
custom claims role (4 values) and tenant (acme-0..49). 4,000 used to train, 1,000 to test.

## Token anatomy today (cb2 at commit 8cd81bc, generated by the library)
- claims JSON: 217 bytes on average (211 to 224)
- cb2.local: 470 chars = prefix "cb2.local." 10 + base64url(32 nonce + 217 claims + 32 tag) 375 + "." 1 + footer 84
- footer is the JSON {"kid":"kcb2.lid.<44 chars>"}, 63 bytes, 84 chars in base64url
- cb2.public: 4,883 chars = prefix 11 + base64url(217 claims + 3,373 signatures) 4,787 + "." 1 + footer 84

## Claims encodings (mean bytes over 1,000 test claim sets)
| encoding | mean | min | max |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| JSON as today | 217.4 | 211 | 224 |
| zstd -19, no dictionary | 161 | | |
| zstd -19 with a 4 KB dictionary trained on the JSON | 62 | 55 | 76 |
| CBOR map with CWT integer keys and epoch integer times | 127.4 | 121 | 134 |
| CBOR "tight": CWT keys, epoch iat, exp as delta from iat, 16-byte binary UUID jti, iss and aud as indexes into a table both sides know | 72.0 | 70 | 73 |
| tight CBOR then zstd with the JSON dictionary | 75 | | |

Notes:
- the dictionary output length varies with the claim values (55 to 76 bytes), a length side channel; the tight CBOR varies only with field lengths (70 to 73).
- zstd level 3 with the dictionary on a 216-byte claims set: 287 MB/s compress, 673 MB/s decompress, i.e. under 1 us each.

## Post-quantum signatures in liboqs 0.16.0 (median of 201 runs, 217-byte message, machine under some load)
| scheme | signature B | public key B | sign us | verify us |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ML-DSA-44 | 2,420 | 1,312 | 86 | 38 |
| ML-DSA-65 (cb2 today) | 3,309 | 1,952 | 120 | 64 |
| Falcon-padded-512 | 666 | 897 | 182 | 31 |
| Falcon-512 | 752 | 897 | 185 | 32 |
| MAYO-1 | 454 | 1,420 | 204 | 73 |
| MAYO-2 | 186 | 4,912 | 143 | 38 |
| UOV OV-Is | 96 | 412,160 | 40 | 19 |
| UOV OV-Ip | 128 | 278,432 | 21 | 18 |
| SNOVA_24_5_4 | 248 | 1,016 | 737 | 278 |
| SNOVA_25_8_3 | 165 | 2,320 | 502 | 225 |
Ed25519 (libsodium) for reference: 64-byte signature, 32-byte key, sign about 19 us, verify about 47 us.
